dishes.n: Green Place garden veg with whipped feta
dishes.make_ahead: Whip the feta dip up to 2 days ahead and trim the vegetables up to 1 day ahead, both chilled; arrange to serve

steps.text: Blitz the feta with the Greek yoghurt, the olive oil, the zest and juice of half a lemon and a handful each of mint and dill until smooth and green flecked.
Spread into a bowl and drizzle with oil.
Trim the radishes and the baby carrots, string the snow peas and cut the cucumber into spears.
Soak the vegetables in iced water 10 minutes, drain and arrange around the dip.

dishes.n: Bullet Farm chorizo with smoky honey
dishes.make_ahead: Slice the chorizo up to 1 day ahead and keep chilled; fry, glaze and grill the bread on the night

steps.text: Slice the chorizo sausages into 1.5cm coins.
Heat a heavy pan over high heat and fry without oil for 4 minutes, turning, until blistered and the fat runs.
Add the honey, the smoked paprika and the sherry vinegar and toss for 1 minute until sticky.
Grill the slices of sourdough until charred.
Serve the chorizo on toothpicks with the bread to mop up the pan juices.

veg.n: Bullet Farm veggie chorizo with smoky honey
veg.make_ahead: Slice the veggie sausages up to 1 day ahead and keep chilled; fry, glaze and grill the bread on the night

steps.text: Slice the veggie sausages into 1.5cm coins.
Heat the oil in a heavy pan over high heat and fry for 4 minutes, turning, until blistered.
Add the honey, the smoked paprika and the sherry vinegar and toss for 1 minute until sticky.
Grill the slices of sourdough until charred.
Serve the coins on toothpicks with the bread to mop up the pan juices.

dishes.make_ahead: Marinate up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Marinate the lamb chops for 1 hour with the chopped rosemary, the garlic cloves, the juice of the lemon and the oil.
Grill over high heat 3 minutes a side.
Grill the corn cobs for 10 minutes alongside and brush with butter.

veg.n: War Rig barbecue haloumi and eggplant
veg.make_ahead: Marinate up to 1 day ahead, keep chilled

steps.text: Marinate the eggplant and haloumi for 30 minutes with the chopped rosemary, the crushed garlic cloves, the juice of the lemon and the oil.
Grill the eggplant over high heat until soft and charred, then grill the haloumi 2 minutes a side.
Grill the corn cobs alongside and brush with butter.

dishes.make_ahead: Best grilled just before serving; warm the honey with the thyme up to 1 day ahead

steps.text: Halve and stone the peaches.
Brush the cut sides with a little oil and grill cut side down for 4 minutes until charred and soft.
Drizzle with the honey warmed with thyme and serve with the vanilla ice cream.

dishes.make_ahead: Best blended just before serving; chill the glasses up to 1 day ahead

steps.text: Chill the tall glasses.
Blend the vanilla ice cream, the cold milk, the malted milk powder and the honey until thick and smooth.
Drizzle a little honey down the inside of each glass, pour in the shake and sprinkle with more malt powder.
Serve straight away with straws.
